article.story: Florida State (3-5) at Boston College (4-4), Nov. 7 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Florida State by 6.5. Against the spread: Florida State 3-4-1, Boston College 5-3. How to watch: ACC Network Key stats Florida State Offense Overall: 414.4 yards per game (45th in FBS) Passing: 248.6 yards per game (43rd) Rushing: 165.8 yards per game (57th) Scoring: 30.6 points per game (54th) Florida State Defense Overall: 424.4 yards per game (127th in FBS) Passing: 247.9 yards per game (114th) Rushing: 176.5 yards per game (111th) Scoring: 28.9 points per game (105th) Boston College Offense Overall: 355.4 yards per game (97th in FBS) Passing: 187.3 yards per game (113th) Rushing: 168.1 yards per game (51st) Scoring: 21.6 points per game (111th) Boston College Defense Overall: 339.4 yards per game (50th in FBS) Passing: 188.5 yards per game (35th) Rushing: 150.9 yards per game (80th) Scoring: 26.5 points per game (91st) Florida State ranks 132nd in the FBS with a -8 turnover margin, compared to Boston College's 45th-ranked +2 margin. Boston College ranks 118th in the FBS averaging 70.6 penalty yards per game, compared to Florida State's 61st-ranked 54.3 per-game average. Boston College is 115th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 90.6% of trips. Florida State's red zone offense ranks 52nd, scoring on 87.1% of red zone opportunities. Florida State ranks 119th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:01, compared to Boston College's 59th-ranked average of 30:19. Team leaders Florida State Passing: Ashton Daniels, 1,968 yards, 14 TDs, 11 INTs, 59.3 completion percentage Rushing: Ousmane Kromah, 609 yards on 114 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Duce Robinson, 438 yards on 24 catches, 4 TDs Boston College Passing: Mason McKenzie, 1,450 yards, 8 TDs, 7 INTs, 58.0 completion percentage Rushing: McKenzie, 638 yards on 132 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Javarius Green, 308 yards on 28 catches, 1 TD Last game Florida State fell to Clemson 36-24 on Oct. 31. Daniels led Florida State with 350 yards on 21-of-33 passing (63.6%) for two touchdowns and three interceptions. He also carried the ball 15 times for 21 yards and one rushing touchdown. Quintrevion Wisner had 43 rushing yards on 13 carries, adding five receptions for 50 yards. Micahi Danzy had four receptions for 108 yards and one touchdown. Boston College was beaten by Duke 47-2 on Oct. 31. McKenzie led Boston College with 87 yards on 9-of-17 passing (52.9%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 13 times for 24 yards. Bo MacCormack III carried the ball nine times for 24 yards, adding one reception for two yards. Jackson Wade had one reception for 36 yards. Next game Florida State plays at Pittsburgh on Nov. 13. Boston College plays at No. 4 Notre Dame on Nov. 14.
